{{Quote|Fuel thieves. Alert our sentries. Protect the shipment at all costs!|Yushyn|audio=Yushyn-Fuel_Thieves.flac|<ref name="The Call" />}}
'''Yushyn''' was a [[Moyn]] [[Gender|male]] who worked as the [[boss]] of a [[Mining Guild]] [[Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[3 BBY]]. Staffed by [[Rodian]] [[Mining Guild guard|employees]], Yushyn's facility refined [[Clouzon-36]] [[gas]], which was used as [[fuel]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]. When a group of [[Realspace|space]]-faring [[Species|creatures]] called [[purrgil]] began [[Diet|eating]] the gas, he ordered his staff to [[Death|kill]] them to prevent losing the resource.

During a round of purrgil shooting, the refinery was [[Heist at the Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|attacked]] by a [[Spectres|band of rebels]] who were trying to [[Thief|steal]] some of the fuel for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|the Rebellion]] and their own [[VCX-100 light freighter|starship]], the ''[[Ghost]]''. Yushyn was dragged down into the [[Unidentified planetoid (Mining Guild)|planetoid's]] depths by a purrgil during the confrontation, which ended with the rebels destroying the refinery and making off with the fuel.

==Biography==
===Mining Guild boss===
{{Quote|These creatures have eaten enough of our fuel. I don't want to hear our cannons stop firing until all of those things are dead.|Yushyn orders his men to kill the purrgil|audio=Yushyn-Enough_Fuel.flac|<ref name="The Call" />}}
[[File:Yushyn_and_hologram.png|thumb|left|200px|Yushyn ordered his men to kill the purrgil to prevent them from consuming the Clouzon-36 gas.]]
In [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology Note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Rebels|The Call}} to [[3 BBY]].</ref> the [[Moyn]]<ref name="The Call" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="DB" /> Yushyn was under the employ of the [[Mining Guild]]<ref name="The Call" /> as the [[overseer]]<ref name="XWing">{{FFGXW2|set=Mining Guild TIE Expansion Pack|cardname=Overseer Yushyn}}</ref> and the [[boss]] of an [[Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery]] built on a small [[Unidentified planetoid (Mining Guild)|planetoid]]<ref name="RefineryDB">{{Databank|asteroid-belt-gas-refinery|Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery}}</ref> in the far reaches of [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="DB" /> The facility was used to collect and refine [[Clouzon-36]] [[gas]] and was [[Mining Guild guard|staffed]] by members<ref name="The Call" /> of the [[Rodian]] [[species]].<ref name="TCEG">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-call-episode-guide|text="The Call" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref>

When a herd of deep-space creatures called [[purrgil]] approached the facility to [[Diet|feed]] on the gas, Yushyn sent out a pair of the Guild's [[TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighter|modified TIE fighters]] to [[Death|destroy]] them. Yushyn later found two of<ref name="The Call" /> his<ref name="DB" /> Rodian workers firing on the purrgil from the refinery with one of the base's [[blaster cannon]]s and questioned why the creatures were still present. After learning that his [[starfighter]]s had stopped responding to hails, he demanded that the cannons in the base keep firing on the purrgil until all of them were dead. The [[TIE series|TIEs]] had, in fact, been destroyed by the ''[[Ghost]]'', a rebel [[VCX-100 light freighter|starship]]. Its [[Spectres|crew]] was searching the area for the refinery with plans to [[Thief|steal]] its [[fuel]] for their own [[Starship|ship]] and the rest of the Rebellion's [[Phoenix Cell|Phoenix Squadron]]. Using the purrgil as a distraction, three members of the ''Ghost's'' crew dropped into the refinery from the ship's position in the planetoid's upper [[atmosphere]] and began [[Heist at the Asteroid Belt Gas Refinery|battling]] the Rodian workers.<ref name="The Call" />

===Battling the rebels===
{{Quote|Wait! Keep away!|Yushyn is grabbed by the purrgil|audio=Yushyn-Death.flac|<ref name="The Call" />}}
While [[Padawan|Jedi apprentice]] [[Ezra Bridger]] covered the rebels on a captured cannon, his [[Jedi Master|Master]], [[Kanan Jarrus]], and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] began securing a landing zone for the ''Ghost'' to begin refueling. Having been alerted to the attack, Yushyn ordered his men to protect a shipment of Clouzon-36 fuel destined for the [[Galactic Empire]] at all costs and then made his way out of the refinery to join the battle. Ordering his remaining two fighters to launch and attack the rebels, who were attempting to load the Imperial shipment onto the ''Ghost'', Yushyn demanded that the thieves surrender to him. The fighting ceased momentarily as the refinery boss waited for the rebels' answer, but it erupted again when the purrgil emerged from the Clouzon-36 surrounding the refinery and attacked the Guild TIE fighters, having [[Taming beasts|allied]] with Bridger.<ref name="The Call" />

[[File:Yushyn_and_the_purrgil.png|thumb|right|250px|Yushyn was surrounded and dragged away by the purrgil.]]
Yushyn ordered his men to concentrate fire on the ''Ghost'' rather than the purrgil when he saw that the rebel crew had finished loading the shipment and were taking off. Heading off on his own to try and provide cover for his men, Yushyn suddenly found himself trapped on one of the refinery's walkways between a pair of purrgil. He yelled at the creatures and attempted to leap from the walkway after one lunged at him but was grabbed up in its [[mouth]] and dragged down<ref name="The Call" /> into the planetoid's depths<ref name="DB" /> beneath the refinery. Having collected the fuel they needed, the rebels then fired upon the refinery from the ''Ghost'' and destroyed it, leaving the planetoid alongside the purrgil, who had consumed their share of gas.<ref name="The Call" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Blast those disgusting things!|Yushyn orders his men to fire on the purrgil during the battle|audio=Yushyn-Disgusting_Things.flac|<ref name="The Call" />}}
The famously grumpy<ref name="BMF84">{{BuildFalconCite|87|Secrets of Spaceflight}}</ref> Yushyn led the operation at the Mining Guild refinery with an unrelenting fervor<ref name="RefineryDB" /> and was an overbearing boss,<ref name="XWing" /> speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard]]<ref name="The Call" /><ref name="Absolutely Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> to his Rodian workers. He considered the purrgil disgusting<ref name="The Call" /> and coldly<ref name="DB" /> ordered his men to kill them in order to stop them from consuming gas. Yushyn was covered in [[Color|brown]] [[Hair|fur]] and skin, and had two black [[eye]]s.<ref name="The Call" />

==Equipment==
[[File:YushynTIE.png|thumb|left|200px|Yushyn flew a modified TIE.]]
Yushyn wore a turquoise-and-yellow [[Clothing|uniform]] that closely matched the outfits worn by the Rodian employees of the Mining Guild refinery. Unlike the Rodians, Yushyn's uniform featured a white utility vest with two pouches at his upper torso and the Mining Guild logo adorned on the front and back. Yushyn also wore a pair of black [[boot]]s.<ref name="The Call" /> He flew in a Mining Guild TIE fighter.<ref name="XWing" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Yushyn_original_concept.png|thumb|right|150px|Yushyn's design was based on concept art drawn by Ralph McQuarrie.]]
Yushyn first appeared in "[[The Call]]," the fifteenth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'',<ref name="The Call" /> which first aired on [[February 10]], [[2016]].<ref name="Release Date">{{TVcom|url=shows/star-wars-rebels/the-call-3343404|text=Star Wars Rebels – Season 2, Episode 13: The Call}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]], who also provided dialogue for one of the episode's Rodian workers.<ref name="The Call" />

The character's design was based on a piece of [[alien]] [[bounty hunter]] concept art drawn by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Concept art of Yushyn for ''Star Wars Rebels'' was produced by artist [[JP Balmet]].<ref name="TCEG" /> The [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 64|sixty-fourth issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s magazine series ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF84" /> which was published around [[March 23]], 2016,<ref name="BMFdate">{{BMFdates|64}}</ref> erroneously refers to Yushyn as a Rodian.<ref name="BMF84" />
